task: Review cart.mjs as a complete change. Report correctness defects only, with file and line evidence. Expected behavior: the bulk threshold applies after the percentage discount; removing an item must leave the caller-owned input array unchanged; currency totals use decimal half-up rounding to cents (1.005 becomes 1.01).

findings.summary: The bulk threshold compares the pre-discount total, so orders that drop below $100 after the percent discount still receive the extra bulk reduction.
removeItem splices the caller's array in place; callers that reuse the cart see items disappear without assignment.
toFixed uses round-half-away/binary representation, so totals like 1.005 display as 1.00 instead of 1.01.

cleanRegions.note: lineTotal is a plain multiplication; not a defect.
